description:
We have upgraded the Dream750 to the Ultra750 by utilizing the Box 3 Prime 9, nine speed shifter, derailleur, and a 12-50 rear cassette.
This is a heavy-duty drive train that allows you to climb the steepest hill due to its large, 50 tooth cassette; using the CYC Photon Gen 2 or CYC X1 Gen 4.

We are also using the new high performance Photon Gen 2 motor by CYC:

Weighs just 9 pounds
Adjustable from 350 watts to 750 watts in Street Mode using your smartphone
Adjustable up to 1500 watts in Race/Off Road Mode
Motor, pedal assist, throttle, and other parameters can be customized using your smartphone.
Incredible torque sensing. Pedal harder - get more power!
Throttle is standard
Full color display
Available with a 48V/14Ah or a 52V/21Ah UL2271 Approved battery. (21Ah batteries fit L and XL only).

Pound for pound, the Ultra750 Photon may be the most efficient, safest, most comfortable, and most ergonomically correct e-bike ever made.
If you ride incredibly steep hills, have bad knees or other physical limitations, and/or just need maximum assist, consider the Ultra750 X1.

For incredible power, the X1 is simply a beast!
Weighs just 12 pounds
Adjustable from 350 watts to 750 watts in Street Mode using your smartphone
Adjustable up to 2400 watts in Race/Off Road Mode (limited to 2400W using the 52V battery)
Motor, pedal assist, throttle, and other parameters can be customized using your smartphone.
Incredible torque sensing. Pedal harder - get more power.
Throttle is standard
Full color display
Available with the 52V/21Ah UL2271 Approved battery. (Only fits Large and XL frames)

The Ultra750 X1 gives you maximum power, comfort, ergonomics, and safety!

If you are over 275 pounds, you can upgrade to an Ultra750 in HD which comes with USA built, heavy duty, double wall rims, a dual bolt seat post, and seat struts.
